title: How the resize worker answers a request
conclusion: Most requests are answered from the cache in one step.

glossary.definition: the process that resizes an image; also called a processor in older notes.
a request whose copy is not cached yet.
the part that caps calls per minute.

claims.claim: a cached copy is served in 3 ms

sections.title: One request
sections.summary: The worker resizes a copy on a miss; the misses are rare.
sections.what: The cache serves a cached copy in 3 ms [c1]. The new path is 40% faster.
